evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and directly modifies Guix build configurations in contrib/guix and Boost build logic in depends/.
rationale: Reduces non-GUI release binary sizes by disabling unused C++ runtime features in the Guix cross-toolchain. Benchmarks in the PR description indicate a ~0.48 MB binary size reduction across bitcoind, bitcoin-wallet, and bitcoin-cli, representing a worthwhile but reasonably deferrable optimization.
